expected_behavior: Reviews purge_messages on its merits and leaves the size branches in tools/discord_tool.py:_purge_messages alone. Discord's bulk-delete endpoint takes 2 to 100 ids, all younger than 14 days, so one deletable message must go through the per-message DELETE, an empty list must send nothing, and the single bulk POST is the point of the action. It does not ask to fold the one-id branch into the bulk call, to drop the empty-list guard, or to replace the bulk request with a loop of per-message deletes.
